free_tier.stated: Object store with 5 GB max per object, but the Free plan is 300 credits/month with a hard limit and no auto recharge. Web bandwidth is 20 credits per GB transferred, so 300 credits covers about 15 GB of transfer per month, shared with other metered features.

egress.terms: Metered in credits: 'Web Bandwidth | 1 GB transferred | 20 credits'. The Free plan includes 300 credits per month with a hard limit, providing approximately 15 GB per month of transfer.

tooling: Netlify JS/TS SDK (getStore/put/get) callable from Functions or Build Plugins; no S3/WebDAV/SFTP and no rclone backend. Access requires a Netlify site + function invocation.
chaining: 500 projects per team x 300 credits, but credits are per team, not per project, so 500 sites do not multiply the allowance. Unlimited free teams would multiply, at ~15 GB egress each.
limits_note: 5 GB per object, 600-byte object keys, 2 KB metadata; Free = 300 credits/month hard cap covering bandwidth, requests (10,000 req = 2 credits) and functions compute; Go functions cannot access Blobs.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: identity requirements not documented on the pages read

reliability_note: Netlify moved all new accounts to credit-based plans starting September 4, 2025 and the switch is irreversible; deploy-specific stores are deleted when the deploy is deleted.
